# Twinthos

> Twinthos is a managed digital-employee company. Twinthos Brain is the persistent intelligence layer for a company's approved knowledge; Twinthos Workforce is the execution layer of cloud-based digital employees that work around the clock inside defined permissions. Promise: work handled, time returned.

## Definition

A digital employee is an AI agent that holds one written job, remembers the company it works for, works through the screens of the software the business already runs, keeps an audit trail of what it did, and escalates consequential decisions to a named human who is accountable for them. It is not a chatbot, not a per-seat assistant, and not a model — the model is swappable fuel.

- [A chatbot answers the question. A digital employee closes the file. Five differences, and only one of them is technical.](https://twinthos.com/notes/digital-employee-vs-chatbot/) — 2026-10-21. A chatbot and a digital employee are not the same product at different prices.

Dell, SAP, Google, Meta and Workday all shipped something between 6 and 13 October that remembers what a business alread.
- [The last time a machine was supposed to erase a job, it made the job better. This time can be the same.](https://twinthos.com/notes/atm-and-bank-tellers/) — 2026-10-14. Everyone says the ATM killed the bank teller.
- [What makes something a real digital employee, and how to tell when you have found one.](https://twinthos.com/notes/what-an-ai-agent-actually-does/) — 2026-10-14. Google, OpenAI, Meta and Anthropic all shipped something called an agent this autumn.

- [95% of AI pilots fail. The 5% that work do three simple things differently.](https://twinthos.com/notes/why-ai-automations-fail/) — 2026-10-14. MIT found roughly 95% of generative AI pilots produced no measurable impact on profit and loss.

- [Half of small businesses already let AI take a job. Nobody was fired. Their people just got their evenings back.](https://twinthos.com/notes/small-businesses-already-hired-ai/) — 2026-10-14. A survey of 729 owners found 53% now let AI absorb a full-time role, and there is no layoff figure in it.
